hooks.command: bash -c 'for d in . */; do [ -f "$d/ai/STANDARDS.md" ] || continue; [ -f "$d/sync-check.sh" ] && ( cd "$d" && bash sync-check.sh ); done; true'
bash -c 'for d in . */; do [ -x "$d/tools/session_hook.sh" ] || continue; "$d/tools/session_hook.sh" start; break; done' 2>/dev/null

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Scaffold checkpoint rule: this session was just COMPACTED, so conversation detail is already gone and only the summary remains. Before continuing, write any decision, gotcha or piece of progress that is not yet recorded into ai/SESSION.md, ai/BACKLOG.md and ai/MEMORY.md. Read those files first if you are unsure what is already there."}}'
bash -c 'for d in . */; do [ -x "$d/tools/session_hook.sh" ] || continue; "$d/tools/session_hook.sh" checkpoint; break; done' 2>/dev/null
bash -c 'for d in . */; do [ -x "$d/tools/session_hook.sh" ] || continue; "$d/tools/session_hook.sh" end; break; done' >/dev/null 2>&1
bash -c 'for d in . */; do [ -x "$d/tools/session_hook.sh" ] || continue; "$d/tools/session_hook.sh" precompact; break; done' >/dev/null 2>&1
bash -c 'for d in . */; do [ -x "$d/tools/session_hook.sh" ] || continue; "$d/tools/session_hook.sh" precompact; break; done' >/dev/null 2>&1
